comparison.objective: Hold a sprung M.2 drive flat and rotate a tool-less latch over its end.
comparison.physical_skill: Simultaneous bimanual spring restraint and quarter-turn latch actuation.
comparison.success_condition: Drive within 2.5 degrees of flat, latch turned at least 70 degrees, both hands at least 3 cm clear, held still for 1 s.
comparison.reason: It tests simultaneous hold-and-latch coordination, whereas the candidate sequentially unlocks, withdraws a bit, tunes a collar, reacquires the moved socket, locks, and commissions dynamic damping.
